pitch: How to set a few ambitious objectives, measure them with key results and align a whole organization, from Intel to Google.
br: objective · key results · what and how
three to five · give things up · priorities
week by week · one OKR · tracking
quiz: Who taught OKRs to John Doerr?
In 1975, in an internal Intel course.
What is the difference between an objective and key results?
The objective says what you want to achieve, the key results how you'll know you got there
Key results are measurable, verifiable and time-bound.
Which one is a good key result?
Get 10,000 new sign-ups by the end of March
A measurable result, not an activity or a vague statement.
How many objectives per team and per period?
Choosing few forces you to give things up and focus.
Intel's 1980 mobilization to win back the microprocessor market
A clear objective cascaded through the whole company in a few weeks.
What score is often considered good for an aspirational OKR?
Always scoring 1 means the objectives were too easy.
The regular exchanges that keep OKRs alive.
Should OKRs be mechanically tied to bonuses?
No, otherwise people will set easy goals
OKRs are a tool for steering and learning, not for sanction.
